intent: No NEW source file over 800 lines (God file). cairn's modules are small, focused statistical units; the ratchet freezes today's state and blocks a new monolith forming. Existing files (if any) are grandfathered.

PRIMARY function-health gate: no NEW function with cyclomatic complexity over 12 (1 + decision points + &&/||). The less-arbitrary signal than length — flags BRANCHY hard-to-test functions, not merely long ones (McCabe ~10; 12 is forgiving). Ratchet grandfathers today's complex functions and blocks any new one.
Coarse BACKSTOP: no NEW function over 150 lines (huge-but-flat functions only; complexity above is the primary gate). Ratchet.
No NEW module imported by more than 12 files (coupling hub). types.ts/index.ts are contract barrels (benign) and are grandfathered; this blocks a NEW everything-depends-on-it module forming.
